changeSet.author: MoonPark
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO moonpark_master_data.parking_zone (zone_code, zone_name, description) VALUES ('M1', 'Rate zone M1', '60 kr per hour, charged per started minute'), ('M2', 'Rate zone M2', '100 kr per started hour on weekdays, 200 kr on weekends'), ('M3', 'Rate zone M3', 'Mon-Sat 08-16 first hour free then 2 kr/min, otherwise 3 kr/min, Sunday free') ON CONFLICT (zone_code) DO NOTHING;
changeSet.rollback: DELETE FROM moonpark_master_data.parking_zone WHERE zone_code IN ('M1', 'M2', 'M3');

changeSet.author: MoonPark
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO moonpark_master_data.permission (permission_name, description) VALUES ('FEE_CALCULATE', 'Calculate a parking fee'), ('FEE_CALCULATE_BATCH', 'Calculate many parking fees in one request'), ('PROFILE_READ', 'Read own profile'), ('TARIFF_READ', 'Read tariff versions'), ('TARIFF_WRITE', 'Create and deactivate tariff versions'), ('CLIENT_MANAGE', 'Manage third-party API clients'), ('USER_READ', 'Read users'), ('USER_MANAGE', 'Create users and change their roles'), ('AUDIT_READ', 'Read the audit trail') ON CONFLICT (permission_name) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: MoonPark
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO moonpark_master_data.role (role_name, description) VALUES ('USER', 'Person who calculates parking fees'), ('EXTERNAL_CLIENT', 'Third-party system using an API key'), ('ADMIN', 'Operates tariffs and API clients'), ('SUPER_ADMIN', 'Full access, including user and role management') ON CONFLICT (role_name) DO NOTHING;

changeSet.author: MoonPark
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO moonpark_master_data.role_permission (role_id, permission_id) SELECT r.role_id, p.permission_id FROM moonpark_master_data.role r JOIN moonpark_master_data.permission p ON (r.role_name = 'USER' AND p.permission_name IN ('FEE_CALCULATE', 'PROFILE_READ', 'TARIFF_READ')) OR (r.role_name = 'EXTERNAL_CLIENT' AND p.permission_name IN ('FEE_CALCULATE', 'FEE_CALCULATE_BATCH', 'PROFILE_READ', 'TARIFF_READ')) OR (r.role_name = 'ADMIN' AND p.permission_name IN ('FEE_CALCULATE', 'FEE_CALCULATE_BATCH', 'PROFILE_READ', 'TARIFF_READ', 'TARIFF_WRITE', 'CLIENT_MANAGE', 'USER_READ', 'AUDIT_READ')) OR (r.role_name = 'SUPER_ADMIN') ON CONFLICT (role_id, permission_id) DO NOTHING;
